title: Network Spotlight (Link Page): the six layouts of the design, per-profile rules, wired through a layout registry

source.ref: Daniel, 2026-10-28: program the new Network design system into the theme system the way Nocturne is. Plan: /mnt/project-files/network-theme/PLAN.html, pass 6 (Spotlight). Design: Spotlight Layouts.html.

verify.evidence: Fails on main (lib/spotlight/layouts.ts does not exist) and passes here: the network-kit Spotlight preset resolves a layout, the registry lists the six for that theme and none for the others, every layout has a component, the sheet and markup hold no raw colour, each of the thirteen profiles has a default layout it can use and clean copy, and a live page carries no sample date, price or testimonial.

detail: Pass 6 of 12. The repo had NO layout plumbing for Spotlight (Nocturne's Spotlight is a colour/face preset; its feature-page phones are screenshots), so this adds it minimally and additively. lib/spotlight/layouts.ts is the registry (layout ids are `<theme>:<layout>`; network-kit registers stack, card-wall, story, calendar-first, shop-front, profile; other themes have none). SpotlightTheme gains optional `layout` and `kit` (validated against the registry; absent on every other theme, so their validated output is byte for byte unchanged, EMPTY_THEME included); the network-kit preset carries network-kit:stack for the general profile. SpotlightShell swaps the identity header and block body for the layout only when theme.layout is set (a `sampleContent` prop, off live, fills the design's sample dates, sessions and quote for previews). components/spotlight/network-kit-layouts.tsx holds the six layouts (Server Component, no hooks; pill buttons, 28px cards, Bricolage headlines with one Instrument Serif italic word, accent-dot labels; the root carries data-house-theme=network-kit and the profile's scheme and inlines NETWORK_KIT_TOKENS_CSS plus network-kit-layouts-css.ts, tokens only). lib/spotlight/network-kit-content.ts holds the per-profile rules: scheme from networkKitProfileScheme; ways in one per tool in ladder order with the profile's labels (Mixers, Chapters, Passes, Member perks and so on); featured item picked gather, learn, book, membership; Calendar first needs meetups and Shop front needs one-to-ones or a shop, the other four always work; each profile starts on one layout (stack for general, schools and clubs; card-wall for networks and venues; story for coaches, nonprofits and faith; calendar-first for studios and hosts; shop-front for creators, wellness and markets). Fonts: the layouts read --font-display/--font-sans/--font-accent with the named faces as the fallback, because a custom property reading an unset next/font variable (--nk-sans etc.) is invalid and a bare var() paints the browser default; the Spotlight route does not yet apply NETWORK_KIT_FONT_CLASS, so a live Network Spotlight shows the named faces only where installed (decision for the lead: add the font class to app/spotlight/[handle]/page.tsx, which keeps fonts off the root layout). VOICE CHANGES from the design: descriptor 'Weekly meetup · Members · Newsletter' to 'Meetups · Members · Email'; eyebrow 'Every Friday morning' to 'When and where you meet'; hero body drops 'weekly'; letter 'One email on Thursday. That is it.' to 'A note before we meet. Nothing extra.' (and each profile's letter lost its cadence: mixers, 'once a month', 'every weekend' reworded); door metas 'First two visits free', 'From $15 a month', '20 minutes · free', '4 weeks · next cohort 3 Nov' replaced by plain 'See the next dates', 'Keep your seat and the directory', 'A short call with an organizer', 'Programs and cohorts'; 'Host guides, mostly free' to 'Guides and recordings'; 'Six chapters and counting', 'Twelve founders, eight weeks, one room every Tuesday', 'Eight owners, one chair, one morning a month', 'every Wednesday', 'Dues' removed; the 'Member name' testimonial and its '4.9' rating are not carried (the quote shows only in a preview, as a one-line sample); 'Gift membership / Give someone a year of meetups' to 'Gift a membership / Give someone a seat at the table'; 'Save a spot' and the 'N left' badge stay only on sample dates. DESIGN NOTES: the design's Spotlight Layouts page uses a 402x874 IOSDevice (0.4599), the build is proofed in the DS 390x844 frame; the design's Socials use Lucide Instagram and Youtube, which Lucide 1 removed, so the build draws Camera, Play and Mail; photos are referenced at /sites/network-kit/photos/ (the assets round); sample dates, sessions and prices appear only when sampleContent is on. PROOF: renders of the six layouts through the real SpotlightShell at Marigold plus Stack in Coral, each beside the design's own, in /mnt/project-files/network-theme/renders/spotlight/.
